description: The site's signature hairline primitive and its most-reused visual device (~40 call sites). A 1px rule with a 1px vertical end-tick at each end, drawn in currentColor, so callers set the colour with text-stroke-1 (light surfaces) or text-stroke-3 (dark surfaces).

hideBottom.note: When true the bottom element is OMITTED, not made transparent — its 16px box is part of the measured height.

knownUpstreamDefect: A stray `hello` class appears on 5 bracket instances in the real source (MobileDrawer, SecurityFeatureAccordion, StatsGrid, industry/FeatureAccordion, platform/StackedPanels). It is dead debug residue carried over from the original and is reproduced on purpose. Generated pages MUST NOT add it.
